| rf_ask_plain | The agency's public data inventory file, called data.json, at each address on record for it. |
| rf_fail | For every data page looked at, one of three things named in the result's reason: the recorded inventory was read and no record names this page's address; or the page is listed but the inventory as a whole fails the schema, possibly in an unrelated record; or no inventory is served at any recorded address. It is not a claim that the dataset is missing from the inventory under some other address, nor that the agency has no inventory at an address not on record for it, such as a parent department's. |
| rf_fix_line | Add the product to the public data inventory already published. |
| rf_hypothesis | Is the data product listed in the agency's public data inventory? Data.gov harvests agency inventories, and catalog-driven discovery (and SI clients that use catalogs to verify a source) find a product only if its record is there. |
| rf_name_brief | The product is listed in the agency's data inventory |
| rf_not_measured | The public client could not finish looking at one or more pages, for one of three reasons: the host turned the identified client away; the client's own honoring of the site's robots.txt stopped it reading the inventory; or a recorded inventory could not be confirmed, or a starting source was not searched, because of a server or network error. |
| rf_partial | Some of the agency's data pages that were looked at met this and some did not. |
| rf_pass | Every data page that was looked at appears in a record that names its address in a DCAT-US address field, inside an inventory that conforms to the federal metadata schema. |
| rf_plain_name | Agency's data.json inventory lists this page, validly |
| rf_question | Is this data product listed, in a valid record, in the agency's public data inventory? |
| rf_requirements | [{"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "develop and maintain a comprehensive data inventory that accounts for all data assets"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "must employ the metadata schema approved by OMB and available on resources.data.gov"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "including in the agency's comprehensive data inventory the URL or persistent identifier"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "Each agency is required to develop and maintain a comprehensive data inventory of all data assets maintained by the agency."}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "commonly known as the JSON format"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "host it publicly on the agency's website at the address: www.[agency].gov/data.json"}, {"source": "m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove", "quote": "When an agency chooses to disseminate a public data asset through the Federal Data Catalog, they do so by including in the agency's comprehensive data inventory the URL or persistent identifier"}, {"source": "dcat-us-1-1-schema", "quote": "This field is not intended for an agency's homepage (e.g. www.agency.gov), but rather if a dataset has a human-friendly"}] |
| rf_rung_two_changes | Nothing: this check needs no key. |
| rf_state | specified |
| rf_tells_plain | Whether the product has a valid entry there, so a catalog can find it. |
| rf_what_client_does | The public client opens the inventory at each recorded location, checks it against the federal metadata schema, and looks for a record that names this data page's address. |
| rf_where_we_look | The agency's public data inventory at each location on record for it — its own data.json file, or a catalog recorded for the agency. |
| rf_who_else | No public tool runs this exact check. |
| rf_why_it_matters | An OMB memo requires each agency to keep a complete data inventory of all its data assets, in JSON, conforming to the federal metadata schema and hosted at the agency's data.json address, and the US DCAT schema (Project Open Data) defines the record's address fields. The rule for deciding that a given page is a given record — matching its address in the record's address fields — is the project's own. |
| rf_why_short | OMB memo M-25-05, Phase 2 Implementation of the Evidence Act, requires every agency to keep a complete data inventory at that address. |
| rule_id | RULE-D4-v5 |
| signal | Fetch /data.json (Project Open Data catalog); validate against the POD v1.1 schema; test whether the product appears in it. |

## Evidence

| doc_id | doc_type | title | locator (evidence cell) |
|---|---|---|---|
| dcat-us-1-1-schema | federal | DCAT-US Schema v1.1 (Project Open Data Metadata Schema) - resources.data.gov | that metadata schema, which states the listing requirement on its face: "guidance to support the use of the Project Open Data metadata to list agency datasets and application programming interfaces as hosted at agency.gov/data", and "the catalog file for each agency should list all of the agency's datasets that can be made public, regardless of whether they are distributed by a file download or a Web API"; its Catalog fields section describes "the entire Public Data Listing catalog file" |
| foundations-for-evidence-based-policymaking-act-of-2018-evid | federal | Foundations for Evidence-Based Policymaking Act of 2018 (Evidence Act) | Title II, the OPEN Government Data Act, enacting 44 U.S.C. 3511: subsection a paragraph 1 requires each agency to "develop and maintain a comprehensive data inventory that accounts for all data assets created by, collected by, under the control or direction of, or maintained by the agency"; subsection a paragraph 3 requires that inventory updated "not later than 90 days" after a data asset is created or identified; subsection b requires public data assets be submitted "for inclusion in the Federal data catalogue"; subsection c paragraph 1 makes that catalogue "a single public interface online as a point of entry" |
| m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove | federal | M-25-05: Phase 2 Implementation of the Evidence Act — Open Government Data Access and Management | section 4a iii, public dissemination: agencies "must submit their comprehensive data inventory to the Federal Data Catalog as a data asset" and "host it publicly on the agency's website at the address: www.agency.gov/data.json", repeated at section 5b ii with the OMB-approved metadata schema |

Evidence cell, verbatim:

> `foundations-for-evidence-based-policymaking-act-of-2018-evid` (Title II, the OPEN Government Data Act, enacting 44 U.S.C. 3511: subsection a paragraph 1 requires each agency to "develop and maintain a comprehensive data inventory that accounts for all data assets created by, collected by, under the control or direction of, or maintained by the agency"; subsection a paragraph 3 requires that inventory updated "not later than 90 days" after a data asset is created or identified; subsection b requires public data assets be submitted "for inclusion in the Federal data catalogue"; subsection c paragraph 1 makes that catalogue "a single public interface online as a point of entry"); `m-25-05-phase-2-implementation-of-the-evidence-act-open-gove` (section 4a iii, public dissemination: agencies "must submit their comprehensive data inventory to the Federal Data Catalog as a data asset" and "host it publicly on the agency's website at the address: www.agency.gov/data.json", repeated at section 5b ii with the OMB-approved metadata schema); `dcat-us-1-1-schema` (that metadata schema, which states the listing requirement on its face: "guidance to support the use of the Project Open Data metadata to list agency datasets and application programming interfaces as hosted at agency.gov/data", and "the catalog file for each agency should list all of the agency's datasets that can be made public, regardless of whether they are distributed by a file download or a Web API"; its Catalog fields section describes "the entire Public Data Listing catalog file")
